The x-axis is labeled 'Number of parameters' and y-axis 'Throughput [fps]', so this description of the axes is factually accurate.
Lower values on the y-axis (Throughput) correctly correspond to lower throughput configurations, which is logically sound.

This is a procedural instruction to compare the configurations to determine the lowest average throughput, with no erroneous data reading or calculation.
